name: Enthalpy v0.4.6
notes:
# Enthalpy v0.4.6

## Changed

- Shows the current phase and progress while Enthalpy sets up Sync or opens a
  workspace from Sync. The workspace stays available during first setup.
- Validates and creates a new local folder from a selected parent folder and
  workspace name when the user opens a workspace from Sync.
- Prevents an old view result from replacing the current result after the user
  quickly changes a view or workspace.

## Fixed

- Prevents rapid local note saves from being handled as external edits. Normal
  task creation and task changes no longer cause a false ambiguous task-marker
  conflict.

## Preview limits

- Hosted Sync remains available only to the approved owner account on macOS
  Apple Silicon and Windows x64.
- Use only disposable test data until the independent protocol and cryptographic
  review is complete.
- Account creation stays invite-only with a hard one-account limit.
